tasks.label: Run Playwright (CI mode diagnostic)
tasks.command: cd Videogames.Web && CI=true npm run test:e2e

tasks.label: Diagnose served frontend
tasks.command: curl -s http://localhost:3000 | rg -n "Marketplace for gamers|Shop by Category|Start Shopping" || true; docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Ports}}' | rg '3000|5017' || true

tasks.label: Commit Web Redesign
tasks.command: git add Videogames.Web/src/app/globals.css Videogames.Web/src/app/layout.tsx Videogames.Web/src/app/page.tsx Videogames.Web/src/app/login/page.tsx Videogames.Web/src/app/register/page.tsx Videogames.Web/src/app/category/[id]/page.tsx Videogames.Web/src/app/create/page.tsx Videogames.Web/src/components/Navbar.tsx && git commit -m "feat(web): apply stitch-dark redesign across core pages and navbar"

tasks.label: Commit Web Redesign Retry
tasks.command: git add Videogames.Web/src/app/globals.css Videogames.Web/src/app/layout.tsx Videogames.Web/src/app/page.tsx Videogames.Web/src/app/login/page.tsx Videogames.Web/src/app/register/page.tsx 'Videogames.Web/src/app/category/[id]/page.tsx' Videogames.Web/src/app/create/page.tsx Videogames.Web/src/components/Navbar.tsx && git commit -m "feat(web): apply stitch-dark redesign across core pages and navbar"

tasks.label: Commit Tooling Updates
tasks.command: git add .env.portainer.example .gitignore .vscode/tasks.json && git commit -m "chore(dev): update local env sample, ignore rules and vscode tasks"
